description: This file provides a lightweight C++ interface for type-safe interoperability between Python and C++ using pybind11, specifically implementing the conduit feature for from-Python-to-C++ conversions. It includes functions to retrieve raw pointers from Python objects, ensuring ABI compatibility and type safety.

methods.name: get_raw_pointer_ephemeral
methods.description: Retrieves a raw pointer from a Python object wrapping a C++ object, using type info and ensuring ABI compatibility.

methods.name: get_type_pointer_ephemeral
methods.description: Template function that returns a typed pointer to a C++ object from a Python object, based on type T.
